not_a_result_set: An EXPECTATION re-derived from archived probes, not a measurement. Never plot it as results: it exists only so a re-run's movement can be attributed.
purpose: EXPECTATION derived from the stored probes of bench/results/archive/gmsh-peer.pre-enginefix.json, re-scored against the current references. Not a measurement, and not fit to publish as results: it is the baseline a re-run is diffed against so movement can be attributed to the mesher, the solver or the truth replacement.

attribution_key.gmsh-mesh+polymesh-solver: mesh is Gmsh and unchanged, so probe movement in a re-run isolates our SOLVER (CG true-residual/acceptance)
attribution_key.polymesh-native: probe movement isolates our default MESHER (feature-aware classification, load-rule asymmetry)
attribution_key.polymesh-native-graded: probe movement isolates the GRADED mesher
attribution_key.rel_err movement with an unchanged probe: purely the truth replacement, already quantified in this file

consistency_check.note: every re-derivable row must reproduce its stored rel_err when scored against the baseline revision's truth; a non-zero count here would mean the peer file and that revision disagree
